how_to_apply: Download and print the prescribed application form.
Fill in the form and sign on all pages and at the places marked.
Scan the form and email it to [email protected] with copy to [email protected], subject: Application for Guest Faculty- Advertisement No. A-03/2026.
Attach only the updated bio-data and documents/degree certificates of the essential qualifications.
Fill the details in the Google form https://forms.gle/xhTRdMfVtmZWqxtD6.
Bring the signed original form, original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies at Interview/Joining.
